integrity: The unrestricted result follows from an explicit finite group-algebra basis argument and elementary inclusion-exclusion. The standalone finite checker is corroborative, not an exhaustive proof for arbitrary grid sizes. Priority claims are conditional on inspected literature, with uninspected plausible sources disclosed.
scientific_limitations: Binary north-east XOR with simultaneous updates on power-of-two rectangular periodic grids; fixed noiseless coordinate sensors and L time samples. Does not address arbitrary dimensions, nonlinear/noisy/mobile observation or other update rules.
title: Diagonal observability and exact sensor census for dyadic torus XOR dynamics
